title: Claudio D. Zivic
vital_facts: Baptized at age eight; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Dina Noemi Alvarez, 13 January 1972, later sealed in the Sao Paulo Brazil Temple. Five children
Education: Accounting degree from the University of Buenos Aires
Employment: Ccertified Public Accountant; Worked in the manufacturing and marketing fields

Counselor in Bishopric; Bishop; Stake High Councilor; Temple Ordinance Worker; Counselor in Stake Presidency (twice); President of Spain Bilbao Mission; Area Seventy and Second Counselor in the South America South Area
First Quorum of the Seventy 2007 - present
